risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail on revenue, gross profit, cash balances, debt, hedges, and operating drivers, but is embedded in lengthy boilerplate risk language and broad forward-looking disclaimers. Key risks include declining natural gas performance, lower gross profit and net income, liquidity and leverage constraints, operational disruptions, commodity-price sensitivity, and counterparty exposure.
